about: Orders with a billing, delivery or credit block, largest value first. count = 100 is the row cap (ordered by value), so small blocked orders such as 1369, 1373 or 1833 are not in it. Value at risk is per currency: 1 609 200 EUR and 449 050 RON, never added together.
underlyingRequests: GET /sap/opu/odata/sap/API_SALES_ORDER_SRV/A_SalesOrder?$filter=HeaderBillingBlockReason ne '' or DeliveryBlockReason ne '' or TotalCreditCheckStatus eq 'B'&$select=SalesOrder,SalesOrderType,SalesOrganization,SoldToParty,CreationDate,RequestedDeliveryDate,TotalNetAmount,TransactionCurrency,HeaderBillingBlockReason,DeliveryBlockReason,TotalCreditCheckStatus,OverallSDProcessStatus&$orderby=TotalNetAmount desc&$top=100
note: Answer of the hackathon MCP server tool (shaped JSON, not the raw OData envelope). 'underlyingRequests' are the OData calls the tool makes, so you can reproduce it with any HTTP client (add sap-client=100&$format=json).
